criteria: data-observatory.html is one self-contained data-analysis app (no charting or data libraries): paste/upload CSV or JSON or generate sample data; inferred and editable column types; sort, filter and calculated columns using a safe expression subset (no unrestricted eval); grouping and pivot summaries; charts drawn with canvas or SVG (line, bar, scatter, histogram, pie) with tooltips and responsive resize; a dashboard of movable panels; descriptive statistics; export and localStorage persistence. It stays usable with about 10k rows.

review.description: Data-analysis workbench: CSV/JSON import, typed columns, filter/pivot, self-drawn charts (line/bar/scatter/histogram/pie) + dashboard panels, stats, export. No chart libraries.
